map_acquisition.user_intent: Acquire the underlying interactive map data and assets to support a similar feature inside Tactician's Loom.
targets: Map background images, dimensions and resolutions, or tiles and zoom metadata if used
Coordinate system, units, origin, axis directions, bounds and image/tile transforms
Exact marker positions, source IDs, entity links, marker types and label/anchor metadata
Layer IDs, category memberships, region definitions and supplied overlays or geometry
Filter IDs and relationships, search fields and defaults as actually observed
Route, part, chapter and story visibility or content conditions
Location contents: shops and stock, items, gatherables, chests, mounts and battalions
Links to acquisition sources, recruitment, quests, class unlocks and paralogues where explicit
Marker icons or sprite sheets, crop rectangles, sizes, anchors and variants
Location links, route URL semantics and supplied view/grouping metadata
limits: Map reader returns the loading shell; loaded spatial data and artwork remain inaccessible.
The site's use of a single image versus tiles, its map library and coordinate conventions are unverified.
Missing content in an extracted route page does not prove route absence.
Acquisition does not establish completion tracking, explored-map carryover or later-part calculations.
map_acquisition.required_capture: Loaded map JavaScript/data and background, tile and marker assets, including requests triggered by route, filter or zoom changes where applicable.

limits: HTML reader often returns only the initial Loading shell; indexed text sometimes contains more data.
Direct HTTPS requests reset during TLS; HTTP returns 503. Downloads and image inspection are blocked by current connectivity, not by an approval rejection.
Blank stat cells remain unreviewed, never assumed zero.
Class skills and training bonuses do not independently establish weapon access.
Listed certification grades are recorded as recommendations; logic and minimum levels remain unproven.
Numeric character display stats may include class or ability adjustments; they are not silently imported as personal base stats.
Paralogue date spans in recruitment summaries are not independently labeled as acceptance windows or completion deadlines.
Known-value agreement applies only to compared fields and records.
